☠️ PGFX SYNAESTHESIA MACHINE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Turn Music into Moving Art — Audio describes the beat. Emotion becomes color. Lyrics become motion.

HOW IT WORKS:
① Audio → SRTCreator transcribes lyrics and extracts emotional scene data
② Lyrics/emotion → VisualThink generates vivid synesthetic visual descriptions (mood-as-color, rhythm-as-motion)
③ Structured output → VisualInstruct extracts JSON: content, style, lighting, palette, action
④ Lyrics → CinemaVisemeRig generates phonetically precise mouth animation frames
⑤ ALL STREAMS CONVERGE into the LTXV pipeline for synchronized music-visual generation

WHY THIS IS UNIQUE: Traditional music videos choreograph TO music. This pipeline treats audio as the SOURCE of visual data — emotion maps to palette, rhythm maps to camera motion, lyrics map to lip-sync.

① AUDIO INPUT
Connect any audio source here.
→ Load Audio node (core)
→ Recorded audio
→ File picker

OUTPUTS: SRT, plain text, structured script, SCREENPLAY (DICT), CHARACTER_TRACK (DICT)
→ SRT feeds CinemaVisemeRig for lip-sync
→ SCREENPLAY informs visual scene planning

2026-06-03 — PGFX Industrial Engineering
Synesthesia Pipeline v1.0

CONVERGENCE POINT:
→ VisualInstruct JSON provides: content, style, camera_language, lighting, mood, palette, era, action
→ CinemaVisemeRig images provide: phonetically accurate mouth animation
→ Audio provides: tempo, rhythm, emotional timing
→ LTXV InContext Sampler generates video with all three streams as conditioning

NOVELTY: This workflow implements a TRUE synesthetic pipeline — the audio waveform is not just a soundtrack, it is THE generative source.
→ Lyrics → lip-sync animation → CinamaVisemeRig
→ Mood/emotion → visual palette → VisualThink→VisualInstruct
→ Rhythm → timing → LTXV InContext Sampler keyframe intervals

This approach is rarely done because it requires a unified pipeline across audio, text, viseme, and video — exactly what PGFX nodes provide.
